data.description:
## Description
**What**: Wire /dso:brainstorm Phase 3 to emit an INTENT_ALLOCATION_BRAINSTORM: JSON ticket comment on the epic, one entry per end-state SC, via ticket-comment-from-file.sh (temp-file write to avoid ARG_MAX).
**Why**: Establishes the first stage of the allocation manifest so the read/merge path has real brainstorm-stage data to consume and preplanning has a seed to reassign from.
**Scope**:
- IN: brainstorm Phase 3 emitter; per-SC entry minted via intent-id-mint.sh with deferred=true and owner_ticket=epic-itself; temp-file write through ticket-comment-from-file.sh.
- OUT: preplanning/impl-plan emitters (sc-3/4); read/validate (sc-5/6); a03c migration backfill (sc-9).

## Done Definitions

- A /dso:brainstorm Phase 3 run on a multi-SC epic posts exactly one INTENT_ALLOCATION_BRAINSTORM: comment on that epic containing one entry per drafted end-state SC ← Satisfies: sc-2
- Each emitted entry has deferred=true, owner_ticket equal to the epic id, and an intent_id minted by intent-id-mint.sh matching the slug regex ← Satisfies: sc-2
- The comment is written through ticket-comment-from-file.sh via a temp file rather than an inline argument, so large epics do not hit ARG_MAX ← Satisfies: sc-2
- When this story is complete, re-running /dso:brainstorm Phase 3 on an epic whose Success Criteria text is unchanged re-uses the existing INTENT_ALLOCATION_BRAINSTORM intent_ids rather than minting new ones; a test asserts identical intent_id sets across two consecutive emitter runs on the same SC set ← Satisfies: sc-2
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic in the brainstorm Phase 3 emitter ← Satisfies: sc-2

## Considerations

- [Stability] Re-running brainstorm on the same SC text must reuse the same intent_id (delegates to draft-1's mint determinism); the emitter must not re-mint fresh ids on re-run.
- [ARG_MAX] Always route the comment body through a temp file; inline JSON in a comment argument breaks on large epics.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a feature planner running /dso:brainstorm, I want Phase 3 to emit an INTENT_ALLOCATION_BRAINSTORM comment seeding every drafted SC, so that intent allocation begins at epic-creation time.
